author: Khan Academy
description:
Engineers from different fields collaborate to solve problems using science, creativity, and communication. The engineering design process involves identifying problems, brainstorming solutions, selecting designs, building models or prototypes, testing, improving, and sharing solutions.

Sections:
00:00 - What is the engineering design process?
00:15 - Who are engineers?
01:06 - Big projects need many kinds of engineers
01:55 - Trial and error vs. the engineering design process
02:31 - Walking through the process with a bike helmet
04:01 - What happens when a test fails?
